title: Exchange miscible viscosity
scope: Implement harmonic dynamic-viscosity exchange for different fluid materials; advertise nothing.
acceptance: Analytic pair and population-ratio sweeps conserve momentum and do not increase kinetic energy.
Zero and unequal viscosity limits plus endpoint reversal pass shared Slang tests.
evidence: PASS: docs/roadmap/evidence/P1-07-miscible-viscosity.json; generated Slang CPU tests cover the analytic law, zero and unequal viscosity, endpoint reversal, three population ratios and three timesteps.
PASS: all sweeps conserve mass-weighted momentum and do not increase mass-weighted kinetic energy; the pair law has non-positive instantaneous power.
PASS: 214/214 CUDA, PTX, Vulkan SPIR-V and Metal mirrors; CUDA/Vulkan production builds; DirectCompute binding tests 4/4; SDK CI 47/47; capability remains unadvertised.
